name: Danganronpa: LIVe or Die
source:
Danganronpa: LIVe or Die is a Fangan made in RPG Maker 2003 by Aru & Raven.

Follow Megumi and 15 other people locked inside a luxurious mansion. An evil mechanical bear known as Monokuma forces them to play a killing game. Will they start killing each other? Who will survive?

Each chapter contains a Daily Life section, which contains various scenes with all the characters and personal Free Time events, and a Deadly Life section which contains a murder investigation and a trial (with several minigames, such as Logic Drive and Letter Labirynth).

[From official [url=https://drliveordie.carrd.co/#about]Carrd[/url]]
translation:
Danganronpa: LIVe or Die是Aru & Raven在RPG Maker 2003中制作的一款Fangan。

跟随被锁在豪华宅邸内的惠和其他15个人。一只被称为“Monokuma”的邪恶机械熊迫使他们玩杀人游戏。他们会开始互相残杀吗？谁能活下来？

每章都包含“日常生活”部分，其中包含所有角色和个人空闲时间事件的各种场景，以及“致命生活”部分，其中包含谋杀调查和审判（带有多个迷你游戏，例如逻辑驱动器和字母迷宫）。

[来自官方 [url=https://drliveordie.carrd.co/#about]Carrd[/url]]
